critiques.claim: Formal analysis enables mathematical proof of correctness and consistency in specifications.
critiques.critique: The Model-Reality Gap: Proving a model has a property does NOT prove that the model represents stakeholder true needs, that environmental assumptions hold, that the abstraction omitted no critical behavior, or that implementation code matches the model.
critiques.nuance: Formal methods are unmatched for eliminating specification ambiguities in high-assurance safety-critical cores.
